parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language in which you want the results to be displayed. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English.

parameters.name: BehaviorType
parameters.description:
The type of the web fallback behavior.

0: returns the specified content.

1: redirects to the specified page.

parameters.name: BodyEncoding
parameters.description:
The encoding type.

0: plain text

1: JSON

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the rule.

0: disables the rule.

1: enables the rule.

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: MaxAllowedMs
parameters.description: The threshold in slow call proportion mode.

parameters.name: MinRequestAmount
parameters.description: The minimum number of requests to trigger circuit breaking.

parameters.name: ResponseContentBody
parameters.description: The HTTP text to be returned.

parameters.name: StatDurationSec
parameters.description: The statistical duration for triggering circuit breaking.

parameters.name: Strategy
parameters.description:
The type of the threshold.

0: slow call proportion

1: failure proportion

parameters.name: TriggerRatio
parameters.description: The request percentage that triggers circuit breaking.
